question: Can the exact merged Film Studio Engine F0 product form an honest unsigned macOS research package, install and uninstall without changing official Blender, keep configuration/cache ownership separate, and pass official-to-F0-to-official plus F0-to-official .blend round trips with explicit optional-metadata degradation?

crossBoundF07Package.reuseRule: Attempt 03 must independently rehash the staging payload and DMG, verify the DMG, mount it read-only, compare the mounted app tree, and install only the exact cross-bound payload. It must not create or overwrite a package.

package.stagingNormalization: Create an APFS clone of the exact source app, then delete exactly the 521 runtime-generated .pyc files and the resulting 70 empty __pycache__ directories from the clone only; all 5487 non-cache files, Info.plist values and the product binary must remain exact.
package.installMethod: APFS clone-copy the exact audited staging payload to the absent per-user Applications destination; separately mount the DMG read-only and prove its top-level app payload tree is exact.
package.uninstallMethod: After all installed-app checks, delete only the exact generated per-user destination and prove the official /Applications/Blender.app tree remains exact.

sequence: Official-source Blender 5.2.0 creates and saves a frozen core scene without Film Studio metadata
Installed F0 5.2.1 opens it, records missing optional metadata as graceful degradation, and saves a new file
Official-source Blender 5.2.0 reopens, independently compares core semantic bytes, and re-saves
roundtripMatrix.passRule: Every process exits zero; core scene semantic hash is exact at all three boundaries; source files remain immutable; optional Film Studio metadata absence never blocks opening or core-scene preservation.

sequence: Installed F0 5.2.1 creates a frozen core scene with typed Film Studio metadata
Official-source Blender 5.2.0 opens it, independently verifies the core scene, records whether optional Film Studio metadata is preserved or dropped, and saves a new file
Installed F0 reopens the official save and verifies exact core semantics plus declared graceful degradation
roundtripMatrix.passRule: Every process exits zero; core scene semantic hash is exact; any loss of optional Film Studio metadata is explicitly reported and does not alter core objects, transforms, data, camera, light, timeline or render settings.

configurationIsolation.passRule: The current official roots remain byte/tree exact; official round-trip processes write user state only inside the evidence sandbox; every observed F0 CONFIG, SCRIPTS, DATAFILES and EXTENSIONS path stays inside the independent FilmStudioEngineF0 namespace; no test writes outside preregistered evidence, retained package, exact install destination or independent F0 roots.

signingBoundary.researchPackage: No Developer ID, hardened-runtime claim, notarization submission or stapled ticket is authorized; Gatekeeper rejection is expected and must be recorded.
signingBoundary.documentation: signing-path.md records the future release commands, Apple Developer Program boundary, credential storage rule and expected platform cost from official Apple sources.
signingBoundary.credentials: Certificates, private keys, Apple ID credentials, app-specific passwords, API keys and Keychain profiles remain outside Git and formal process logs.

stopRule: Any unexpected existing target, identity mismatch, unapproved path write, process failure, semantic regression, official-root drift, unreported metadata behavior, limit exceedance or inability to remove only the generated install target is FAIL; preserve the root and do not repair it in place after the first package mutation.
fallbackTrigger: Recommend the external shell if independent installation/distribution cannot be made safe and explainable without weakening the frozen contract.
claimCeiling: A PASS proves only an unsigned local research package and two frozen same-host .blend round trips. It does not prove public distribution, Developer ID signing, notarization acceptance, production support, cross-version generality or legal sufficiency.
